'''Quambah''' was a game played on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vernet]]. The game was often played in the afternoons on [[Maz-Verlin]]'s [[Center Street]], mainly by a group of boys led by [[Kristoff Stonelaw]]. Once the majority of the planet's young men had been conscripted by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], the games were not played anymore.<ref name="TD">{{JournalCite|15|The Draw}}</ref>
